answer: Sybil rings die on capital plus calendar cost, not on identity checks. Make every join post a bond held in a glacier-slow escrow that only unlocks after N epochs of countersigned work, so a thousand clones must lock a thousand real stakes and then wait. Route each attestation through a prism of graders drawn independently per epoch, and let standing at the zenith of that panel be earned fresh each close, never transferred between wallets. Faking an army now costs unrecoverable capital and weeks of idle time before a single clone earns.
